## 0.0 Introduction and Set-up

In this script I will compare the results of the EWAS's in the 450K and SPAH datasets for eoPRED score.

NOTE: When I first wrote these scripts I called the 450K Dataset the 'Discovery Cohort' and the SPAH Dataset the 'Validation Cohort'. You may still see objects named this way.

### 0.1 Packages

```{r packages}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)
library(forestplot)
library(cowplot)
library(ggh4x)
library(missMethyl)

#load the 450K probe information
probeInfo_450k <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19::Locations, 
  IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19::Other, 
  IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19::Manifest))
probeInfo_450k$probeID <-rownames(probeInfo_450k)

chrXprobes_450k <- probeInfo_450k %>% filter (chr == "chrX") 
chrYprobes_450k <- probeInfo_450k %>% filter (chr == "chrY") 
remove(probeInfo_450k)

#load the EPIC probe information
probeInfo <- readRDS("//fs/teams/RobinsonLab/Hannah/05_Projects/SPAH/E. Sex and Environment Project [abandon]/02_Outputs/02_Variability/hg38_b5_EPIC_probeinfo.rds")
probeInfo <- probeInfo %>% mutate(Start_hg38 = as.numeric(Start_hg38))

chrXprobes_EPIC <- probeInfo %>% filter(chr == "chrX")
chrYprobes_EPIC <- probeInfo %>% filter(chr == "chrY")
remove(probeInfo)

set.seed(4815)
theme_set(theme_minimal())
theme_update(
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.text = element_text(size=12),
  plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size = 14, face ="bold"),
  legend.position="none"
  )

```


### 0.2 Load Linear Modelling Data

```{r data}

disc_lm_eopred_fx <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/04_450K_EWAS/lm_eopred2_fx.RDS"))
disc_lm_eopred_mx <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/04_450K_EWAS/lm_eopred2_mx.RDS"))
disc_lm_eopred_my <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/04_450K_EWAS/lm_eopred2_my.RDS"))

val_lm_eopred_fx <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/05_SPAH_EWAS/lm_eopred2_fx.RDS"))
val_lm_eopred_mx <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/05_SPAH_EWAS/lm_eopred2_mx.RDS"))
val_lm_eopred_my <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/05_SPAH_EWAS/lm_eopred2_my.RDS"))

```

## 1.0 Comparison 

1. Plot the regression coefficients in the two cohorts against one another
2. Are any of the hits replicated? (p-value<0.05 & delta-beta in the same direction?)

### 1.1 Females X chr

```{r eopred-fx}

table(disc_lm_eopred_fx$probeID %in% val_lm_eopred_fx$probeID) #8350 probes overlap

#combine 
colnames(val_lm_eopred_fx) <- paste0(colnames(val_lm_eopred_fx),"_val")
colnames(val_lm_eopred_fx)

lm_eopred_fx <- disc_lm_eopred_fx %>%
  inner_join(val_lm_eopred_fx, by=c("probeID"="probeID_val"))
dim(lm_eopred_fx)
cor.test(lm_eopred_fx$delB, lm_eopred_fx$delB_val) #R=0.4929

chrX_xx_rep_hits <- lm_eopred_fx %>% filter(fdr_val<0.05 & delB_val>0.25 & p.value<0.05)
dim(chrX_xx_rep_hits)

```

### 1.2 Males X chr

```{r eopred-mx}

table(disc_lm_eopred_mx$probeID %in% val_lm_eopred_mx$probeID) #8350 probes overlap

#combine 
colnames(val_lm_eopred_mx) <- paste0(colnames(val_lm_eopred_mx),"_val")
colnames(val_lm_eopred_mx)

lm_eopred_mx <- disc_lm_eopred_mx %>%
  inner_join(val_lm_eopred_mx, by=c("probeID"="probeID_val"))
dim(lm_eopred_mx)
cor.test(lm_eopred_mx$delB, lm_eopred_mx$delB_val) #R=0.6623

chrX_xy_rep_hits <- lm_eopred_mx %>%
                          filter(fdr_val<0.05 & abs(delB_val)>0.25 & p.value<0.05 |
                                   fdr<0.05 & abs(delB)>0.25 & p.value_val<0.05)
dim(chrX_xy_rep_hits)

```

### 1.3 Y chr

```{r eopred-my}

table(disc_lm_eopred_my$probeID %in% val_lm_eopred_my$probeID) #198 probes overlap

#combine 
colnames(val_lm_eopred_my) <- paste0(colnames(val_lm_eopred_my),"_val")
colnames(val_lm_eopred_my)

lm_eopred_my <- disc_lm_eopred_my %>%
  inner_join(val_lm_eopred_my, by=c("probeID"="probeID_val"))
dim(lm_eopred_my)
cor.test(lm_eopred_my$delB, lm_eopred_my$delB_val) #R=0.7314

chrY_rep_hits <- lm_eopred_my %>% filter(delB>0.25 & fdr<0.05)
dim(chrY_rep_hits)

```

```{r compare-models}

sup_fig5d <- lm_eopred_fx %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=delB, y=delB_val))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.5)+
  stat_cor()+
  labs(x=expression(paste(Delta*beta, " eoPRED score 450K")),
       y=expression(paste(Delta*beta, " eoPRED score SPAH")))

sup_fig5e <- lm_eopred_mx %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=delB, y=delB_val))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.5)+
  stat_cor()+
  labs(x=expression(paste(Delta*beta, " eoPRED score 450K")),
       y=expression(paste(Delta*beta, " eoPRED score SPAH")))

sup_fig5f <- lm_eopred_my %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=delB, y=delB_val))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.5)+
  stat_cor()+
  labs(x=expression(paste(Delta*beta, " eoPRED score 450K")),
       y=expression(paste(Delta*beta, " eoPRED score SPAH")))

sup_fig5def <- plot_grid(sup_fig5d, sup_fig5e, sup_fig5f,nrow=1,
                         labels = c("D.","E.","F."))
sup_fig5def

sup_fig5abc <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/04_450K_EWAS/450K_compare_models.rds"))

sup_fig5 <- plot_grid(sup_fig5abc, sup_fig5def, nrow=2)

ggsave("Sup_Figure_5.png", plot = sup_fig5, path = here::here("02_Outputs/06_Cohort_Comparison"), width = 13, height =10, device = "png")


```


## 2.0 Enrichment Analysis

### 2.1 gometh

Look at what gene ontology terms are enriched in the CpGs differentially methylated by eoPRED score using the `missMethyl` package function `gometh`. It isn't very useful though for the X and Y chromosomes.

```{r go-analysis}

hits_fx <- (lm_eopred_fx %>%
    filter(sign(delB) == sign(delB_val)) %>%
      filter (p.value < 0.05 & p.value_val < 0.05) %>%
      filter(fdr<0.05 | fdr_val<0.05) %>%
      filter(abs(delB)>0.1 | abs(delB_val)>0.1))$probeID
length(hits_fx)

hits_mx <- (lm_eopred_mx %>%
    filter(sign(delB) == sign(delB_val)) %>%
      filter (p.value < 0.05 & p.value_val < 0.05) %>%
      filter(fdr<0.05 | fdr_val<0.05) %>%
      filter(abs(delB)>0.1 | abs(delB_val)>0.1))$probeID
length(hits_mx)

hits_x <- unique(c(hits_fx, hits_mx))
length(hits_x)

go_x <- gometh(sig.cpg = hits_x,
                    all.cpg = val_lm_eopred_fx$probeID,
                    array.type = "EPIC")

go_x <- go_x %>% mutate(GOterm = rownames(go_x)) %>% as_tibble %>% arrange(FDR)
go_x %>% filter(FDR < 0.05) %>% nrow() #0 significantly associated terms
go_x[1:10,]


go_my <- gometh(sig.cpg = hits_my,
                    all.cpg = lm_eopred_my$probeID,
                    array.type = "EPIC")

go_my <- go_my %>% mutate(GOterm = rownames(go_my)) %>% as_tibble %>% arrange(FDR)
go_my %>% filter(FDR < 0.05) %>% nrow() #0 significantly associated terms
go_my[1:10,]

```

### 2.2 TFBS

chromHMM consensus from Roadmap, original ID: EPIC.hg19.REMC.chromHMM.tsv.gz
	sequence context group
		CpGs associated with consensus TFBS from Cistrome/ENCODE
		EPIC probes associated with tissue-specific methylation
		CpGs associated with consensus histone modifications from Cistrome/ENCODE
		CpG island (Island, S_Shore, N_Shelf, N_Shore, S_Shelf) using CGIposition column in EPIC.hg38.manifest

```{r tfbs-analysis}

library(sesame)
sesameDataCache()

sesame::KYCG_listDBGroups("EPIC")

dbs <- c("KYCG.EPIC.chromHMM.20211020",
         "KYCG.EPIC.TFBSconsensus.20211013",
         "KYCG.EPIC.HMconsensus.20221013",
         "KYCG.EPIC.CGI.20210713")

gene_ea <- testEnrichment(hits_x, databases=dbs, platform = "EPIC")
KYCG_plotDot(gene_ea)
KYCG_plotEnrichAll(gene_ea)

gene_ea_my <- testEnrichment(hits_my, databases=dbs, platform = "EPIC")
KYCG_plotDot(gene_ea_my)
KYCG_plotEnrichAll(gene_ea_my)

write.csv(gene_ea, here::here("02_Outputs/06_Cohort_Comparison/enrichment_analysis.csv"), row.names =F)

```

## 3.0 Replicated Hits Plots

```{r prep-for-plot}

#load beta-values
#discovery cohort
disc_pDat <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/01_450K_Proc/pDat_filt.RDS"))
disc_betas <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/01_450K_Proc/betas_adjdas_filt.RDS"))
dim(disc_pDat) #354 samples
dim(disc_betas) #x354
## Remove samples with chromosome abnormalities
disc_pDat <- disc_pDat %>% filter(!Sample_ID %in% c("GSM2589548","GSM2674422"))
dim(disc_pDat) #352
disc_betas <- disc_betas [,disc_pDat$Sample_ID]
dim(disc_betas) #352

#validation cohort
val_pDat <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/02_SPAH_Proc/val_cohort_metadata.RDS"))
val_betas <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/02_SPAH_Proc/val_cohort_betas_adjdas.RDS"))
dim(val_pDat) #493 samples
dim(val_betas) #x493

rep_hits <- unique(c(chrX_xx_rep_hits$probeID, chrX_xy_rep_hits$probeID, chrY_rep_hits$probeID))
length(rep_hits)

probe_levels <- c("cg22683858", "cg19321437","cg08559914","cg10840597","cg02212907",
"cg22844265","cg05071823","cg19227523","cg00422452","cg26359388",
"cg16520030","cg20978230","cg07924363","cg05672930","cg17660627")

probe_labs <- c("cg22683858\nAmbiguous", "cg19321437\nBoth sexes",
                "cg08559914\nSex-differential","cg10840597\nBoth sexes",
                "cg02212907\nSex-differential", "cg22844265\nAmbiguous",
                "cg05071823\nBoth sexes","cg19227523\nSex-differential",
                "cg00422452\nSex-differential","cg26359388\nBoth sexes",
                "cg16520030\nSex-differential","cg20978230\nBoth sexes",
                "cg07924363\nSex-differential",
                "cg05672930\nY chr","cg17660627\nY chr")

names(probe_labs) <- probe_levels
  
```

```{r plot}

disc_pDat_xx <- disc_pDat %>% filter(DNAme_Sex == "XX")

disc_betas[rownames(disc_betas) %in% chrYprobes_450k$probeID, 
                         colnames(disc_betas) %in% disc_pDat_xx$Sample_ID] <- NA

disc_hits <- disc_betas[rep_hits, ,drop=F] %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var="Sample_ID") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Sample_ID, names_to ="probeID",values_to="Beta")%>%
  left_join(disc_pDat, by="Sample_ID") %>%
  mutate(probeID = factor(probeID, levels = probe_levels))

sup_fig7a <- disc_hits %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=EOPE, y=Beta, color=DNAme_Sex))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.5)+
  geom_smooth(method="lm",se=F)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#bf4e52","#407799"))+
  ylim(0,1)+
  xlim(0,1)+
  theme(strip.text = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=12))+
  labs(x="eoPRED score", y= expression(paste("DNAme (",beta,")")), color="Sex")+
  facet_wrap2(~probeID, ncol=5, labeller =  labeller(probeID = probe_labs))

###

val_pDat_xx <- val_pDat %>% filter(Sex_Predic == "XX")

val_betas[rownames(val_betas) %in% chrYprobes_EPIC$probeID, 
                         colnames(val_betas) %in% val_pDat_xx$rgset_colnames] <- NA

val_hits <- val_betas[rep_hits, ,drop=F] %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var="rgset_colnames") %>%
  pivot_longer(-rgset_colnames, names_to ="probeID",values_to="Beta")%>%
  left_join(val_pDat, by="rgset_colnames") %>%
  mutate(probeID = factor(probeID, levels = probe_levels))

sup_fig7b <- val_hits %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=EOPE, y=Beta, color=Sex_Predic))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.5)+
  geom_smooth(method="lm",se=F)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#bf4e52","#407799"))+
  ylim(0,1)+
  xlim(0,1)+
  theme(strip.text = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=12),
        legend.position="bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size=16))+
  labs(x="eoPRED score", y= expression(paste("DNAme (",beta,")")), color="Sex")+
  facet_wrap2(~probeID, ncol=5, labeller =  labeller(probeID = probe_labs))

sup_fig7 <- plot_grid(NULL,sup_fig7a, NULL,sup_fig7b,
                      nrow=4, labels=c("450K Dataset","","SPAH Dataset",""),
                      rel_heights = c(0.01,1,0.01,1))

ggsave("Sup_Figure7_2026.svg", plot = sup_fig7, path = here::here("02_Outputs/06_Cohort_Comparison"), width = 17, height =16, device = "svg")


```

##4.0 Save Objects

```{r prepare-to-save}

lm_eopred_fx_save <- lm_eopred_fx %>%
  filter(fdr_val<0.05 & fdr<0.05)%>%
  # filter(sign(delB) == sign(delB_val))%>%
  # filter(abs(delB)>0.1 & abs(delB_val)>0.1)%>%
  dplyr::select(probeID, p.value, fdr, delB,
                p.value_val, fdr_val, delB_val) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    `450K_pval` = p.value,
    `450K_fdr` = fdr,
    `450K_delB` = delB,
    SPAH_pval = p.value_val,
    SPAH_fdr = fdr_val,
    SPAH_delB = delB_val) %>%
  left_join((chrXprobes_EPIC %>% dplyr::select(probeID, chr,pos, UCSC_RefGene_Name,
                                               GencodeBasicV12_NAME, Regulatory_Region)))
dim(lm_eopred_fx_save) #97 (36) probes

lm_eopred_mx_save <- lm_eopred_mx %>%
  filter(fdr_val<0.05 & fdr<0.05)%>%
  # filter(sign(delB) == sign(delB_val))%>%
  # filter(abs(delB)>0.1 & abs(delB_val)>0.1)%>%
dplyr::select(probeID, p.value, fdr, delB,
                p.value_val, fdr_val, delB_val) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    `450K_pval` = p.value,
    `450K_fdr` = fdr,
    `450K_delB` = delB,
    SPAH_pval = p.value_val,
    SPAH_fdr = fdr_val,
    SPAH_delB = delB_val) %>%
  left_join((chrXprobes_EPIC %>% dplyr::select(probeID, chr,pos, UCSC_RefGene_Name,
                                               GencodeBasicV12_NAME, Regulatory_Region)))
dim(lm_eopred_mx_save) #736 (203) probes

lm_eopred_my_save <- lm_eopred_my %>%
  filter(fdr_val<0.05 & fdr<0.05)%>%
  # filter(sign(delB) == sign(delB_val))%>%
  # filter(abs(delB)>0.1 & abs(delB_val)>0.1)%>%
dplyr::select(probeID, p.value, fdr, delB,
                p.value_val, fdr_val, delB_val) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    `450K_pval` = p.value,
```
